critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~940 lines — well past 700-line threshold. Split into modules: auth.py, destinations.py, partners.py, itineraries.py, reviews.py, storage.py, planner.py.

wishlist_events collection has no TTL index and no dedup — one destination can be added/removed/added repeatedly, inflating trending counts. Consider unique (user_id, destination_id) event, or count distinct users per dest.
GET /api/partners default status='approved' but a client passing ?status=all works; consider also validating type/status query enum to reject typos.
POST /api/partners has no rate limiting — public endpoint could be spammed with fake pending partners. Add basic IP/session throttle.
ItineraryIn does not cap content length — a large streamed markdown blob could bloat Mongo docs. Add max_length (e.g., 20000).
